data.found_evidence: Output file tail 'unit_tests: UNAVAILABLE' after 'you are #6 in the queue'; ps -o pid,etime,cmd -p 2996432 showed 2h elapsed, process alive; gate status listed '[ ] unit_tests'.
data.summary: Started `ddflow gate run BG-measure unit_tests --timeout 21600` detached with DDFLOW_CI_SUITE_WAIT_S=21600 while about 10 runs were queued. After 2h the output ended with 'unit_tests: UNAVAILABLE', yet the gate run process was still alive (ps -p showed it) and `ddflow gate status` still showed unit_tests unrecorded.
data.title: unit_tests gate prints UNAVAILABLE after the suite-queue wait but the gate run process stays alive and nothing is recorded

data.body:
Fixes bug Bci-gitleaks-over-the-pushed-commi-858efc87b3-e32e69f: The CI check 'gitleaks over the pushed commits (CI: Secrets)' fails on e32e69f0fbb0 (merge). Run `ddflow ci run` to see it.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-Bci-gitleaks-over-the-pushed-commi-858efc87b3-e32e69f --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed Bci-gitleaks-over-the-pushed-commi-858efc87b3-e32e69f --regression-test <test>` first).

FINDING (lane-batch-queue): the post-merge check exports no PRE_COMMIT_FROM_REF, so scripts/ci/gitleaks-pushed.sh scans origin/main..HEAD, which was 7700 unpushed local commits at e32e69f0 (git rev-list --count origin/main..e32e69f0). The BG-measure merge itself added 6 commits and its diff has no key-like strings; the main merge only fast-forwarded. gitleaks is not installed on this host, so the tripping commit is unconfirmed. Fix: the post-merge hook scans only the merged commits (the merge's first-parent range).
